title: 2nd tornado confirmed in the Philadelphia region; cleanup continues from storms | LIVE UPDATES

 2nd tornado confirmed in the Philadelphia region; cleanup continues from storms | LIVE UPDATES 
 Last updated: Friday, November 13, 2026 6:34PM GMT 
 Tornado aftermath after twister confirmed in Burlington County, NJ WPVI A line of powerful storms swept through the Philadelphia region on Thursday afternoon, spawning two tornadoes in our area and leaving behind damaged buildings, toppled trees and piles of hail.
 The National Weather Service confirmed a tornado touched down in New Castle County, Delaware . A hotel sign fell and crushed cars in a parking lot and a medical helicopter had part of its main rotor torn off.
 Investigators have also confirmed that a tornado touched down in Burlington County, New Jersey.
 Meanwhile, it was a shocking sight in Delaware County, where so much hail fell it looked as if communities there were buried under a blanket of snow. 
 4:21 PM GMT 
 Tornado confirmed in Burlington County: NWS 
 The National Weather Service confirmed on Friday that a tornado hit Burlington County.
 The twister touched down in the area of Old York Road as severe weather swept through the region on Thursday.
 No other details have been released but more is expected later Friday.
 A man shows off storm damage after a confirmed tornado tore through Burlington County, New Jersey 3:46 PM GMT 
 Video shows tornado forming in New Castle County, Delaware 
 Video taken by Rob at the Holly Oak Service Center in New Castle County, Delaware shows a tornado forming during severe weather on Nov. 12, 2026.
 By 6abc Digital Staff 12:58 PM GMT 
 Tesla camera captured garbage cans flying down street during Newark tornado 
 A tornado touched down in Newark, Delaware, leaving a trail of destruction.
 The powerful winds sent debris flying, damaged cars and homes and uprooted trees.
 In Chapman Woods, a Tesla camera captured garbage cans flying down the street.
 12:43 PM GMT 
 Video shows hail piling up on cars in Collingswood 
 The same storm also wreaked havoc on parts of South Jersey.
 You could see the hail piling up on cars and along the street in Collingswood on Thursday.
 The same storm also wreaked havoc on parts of South Jersey. A viewer in Gloucester City also sent Action News a video of hail collecting quickly on the ground.
